en.p: There is a regular tetrahedron ABCD in coordinate space. Let $S$ be the sphere centered at the circumcenter of the equilateral triangle BCD and passing through point B. Let P be the point other than B where sphere $S$ meets segment AB, Q the point other than C where sphere $S$ meets segment AC, and R the point other than D where sphere $S$ meets segment AD, and let $\alpha$ be the plane tangent to sphere $S$ at point P.
When the radius of sphere $S$ is 6, the area of the orthogonal projection of triangle PQR onto plane $\alpha$ is $k$. Find the value of $k^2$. [4 points]
